responsibility: Implements the out-of-line arithmetic and conversion logic for GCC’s two-word double_int integer type, which underpins constant folding and fixed-point support when values must be manipulated wider than a single HOST_WIDE_INT. This file owns the nontrivial signed/unsigned add, negate, multiply, divide-and-round, shift, comparison, decimal dumping, and GMP import/export routines that operate on the low/high word representation declared in double-int.h, producing normalized double_int results and bridges to tree type bounds and mpz values.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line implementation for the double_int interface declared in gcc/double-int.h, including the heavier arithmetic, comparison, decimal dump, and GMP import/export routines that are not defined inline in the header.
